title: recordverdict-cli-door
intention: `cairn recordverdict` — the gate act fired from the gate owner's OWN SHELL: a bin/cmd door wrapping learning_block.record_verdict. It must indicate WHICH thing the verdict is for: with more than one finding in flight, the command takes the block/finding it judges; with exactly one pending, naming it may be optional but the record always carries it. An ambiguous act is refused with the candidates LISTED (the named-lack pattern) — never guessed. Signal (approve|disprove|question) + Akien's words ride as arguments; the record lands through the primitive's sole write path, nothing new touches CairnCommons/learning/ directly. AMENDED 2026-08-01 at Akien's order ('i still want /recordverdict but more importantly, we'll need to automate this gating process. … approved, go go go!'): the build is now CURRENT, and the door grows the automation half — (a) `cairn recordverdict` bare LISTS what stands at his gate (pending findings: emitted, no verdict yet) with their bullets; (b) the session-open surface adds an AT-YOUR-GATE lane so pending findings reach him without anyone remembering to ask; (c) the gate name is DERIVED from the finding's block, never typed — the 2026-08-01 mislabel (gate-record lb-20260801-f4f21cbb wrote gate='akien' where the block name was the convention) is the measured defect this kills.
why: Akien, 2026-08-01, at the FIRST live verdict: he typed `cairn record_verdict "Approved - ..."` and the door did not exist — his act had to route through CC's keystroke, the exact indirection the verbatim rule guards against. Then: 'lets make it recordverdict. but sooner or later we will have more than one thing in flight at a time, so we'll need to be able to indicate which thing it's for. ticketable, don't have to build it urgently.' Not urgent is his words — this ticket carries the IOU without blocking the deploy pass.
traces_to: Law 6 — the gate is Akien's; the door puts his act in his own hand, no intermediary keystroke
Law 7 — an ambiguous verdict target is refused naming every candidate, never resolved silently
learning_block charter filed edge (g) — this ticket is that edge's disposition
ticket learning-block-primitive (the organ this door fronts)

proves_green.prove_gate: proof gate — the tester runs the door's proof and emits a VALIDATION.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) with multiple findings pending, the command records a verdict without the target named — or refuses without LISTING the candidates; (2) a verdict lands with empty or CC-authored words where Akien's verbatim belongs; (3) the door writes to CairnCommons/learning/ by any path other than learning_block.record_verdict (a second writer, the validation-store trouble's shape); (4) an invented finding id is accepted rather than refused against the trace berth's actual contents.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read when it builds: if by then delegation has begun (edge c), the door needs the inspector-verdict path too — decide then, not now.
